dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast, dark, irregular outer perimeters and lighter interior centers. The geometry is characterized by sharp, non-uniform transitions from the dark boundary to the lighter core, particularly visible in a cluster of five interlocking rings in the central-left quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters in the posterior region. A single, large high-intensity (bright) amorphous blob is localized in the anterior-lateral region, lacking internal gradients and contrasting sharply with the surrounding textured pattern.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest central annuli form an obtuse triangle. This primary cluster is spatially linked to a secondary, smaller linear alignment of three centroids located along the ventral-lateral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, high-intensity luminous patch on the far left of the frame that disrupts the uniform annulated texture topology.
